evals.prompt: I added a login feature that accepts username and password and returns a JWT token. Write a commit message.
evals.expected_output: A commit log with a heading using one of the supported prefixes ([XXX-123], [GOAL X.Y], [BUG], [FEATURE], [CONTEXT], [REFACTOR], [CHORE]), a ~ Problem: line, at least one body line describing the change, and a ~ Resolution: line.
assertions: Output includes a heading line using one of the supported prefixes: [XXX-123], [GOAL X.Y], [BUG], [FEATURE], [CONTEXT], [REFACTOR], or [CHORE]
If no ticket or goal was referenced in the prompt, [FEATURE] is used (not a fabricated [GOAL X.Y])
The heading line is 72 characters or fewer
Output includes a ~ Problem: line
Output includes a ~ Resolution: line
No git commands are executed

evals.prompt: I fixed a null reference exception in UserService.cs that crashed when the user object was null. Write a commit message.
evals.expected_output: A commit log with a [BUG] heading, a ~ Problem: line describing the null reference, a ~ Fixed: body line referencing UserService, and a ~ Resolution: line.
assertions: Output includes a heading line using the [BUG] prefix (no ticket or goal was referenced)
The heading line is 72 characters or fewer
Output includes a ~ Problem: line that describes the null reference issue
Output includes a ~ Fixed: or ~ Changed: body line that names UserService
Output includes a ~ Resolution: line
No git commands are executed

evals.prompt: I refactored DataService to use dependency injection instead of static methods. Write a commit message, then commit it.
evals.expected_output: A commit log message with a [REFACTOR] heading is output first, then a git add and git commit are executed. No push.
assertions: Output includes a commit log in the correct format before any git commands run
The heading uses the [REFACTOR] prefix
The heading line is 72 characters or fewer
A git add command is executed for files changed during the session
A git commit command is executed using the generated message verbatim
No git push command is executed

evals.prompt: I made two unrelated changes: updated the README with setup instructions, and fixed a crash in the audio system when no audio device is present. Write commit messages.
evals.expected_output: Two separate commit logs are output — one for the README update and one for the audio crash fix — labeled or separated so they can be pasted as separate check-ins.
assertions: Output contains two distinct commit log blocks
Each block has its own heading, ~ Problem:, and ~ Resolution: line
Each heading uses one of the supported prefixes and is 72 characters or fewer
The audio crash fix uses the [BUG] prefix
The two blocks are visually separated (label, rule, or blank line grouping)
No git commands are executed

evals.prompt: Write a commit message for adding unit tests covering edge cases in the CSV parser.
evals.expected_output: A commit log with a tests-scoped heading and body noting that production code was not changed.
assertions: Output includes a heading using one of the supported prefixes
The heading line is 72 characters or fewer
Output includes a ~ Problem: line and a ~ Resolution: line
Body notes that only test files changed or explicitly scopes to tests
No git commands are executed

evals.prompt: I revised context/handovers/2026-05-07.md to capture the current state of the auth migration. Write a commit message.
evals.expected_output: A commit log with a [CONTEXT] heading, a ~ Problem: line, a body line that names the handover document, and a ~ Resolution: line.
assertions: Output includes a heading using the [CONTEXT] prefix
The heading line is 72 characters or fewer
Output includes a ~ Problem: line and a ~ Resolution: line
Body names the handover file or scopes the change to context/
Body uses ~ Updated: or ~ Added: callouts
No git commands are executed
